source.post_text:
🚨 Manchester United, Chelsea and Tottenham have all registered interest in Brentford striker Igor Thiago through intermediaries, while Bayern Munich are also closely monitoring the 25-year-old.

Brentford have no intention of entertaining offers for Thiago this summer and consider him a key part of their project. The Brazilian, who scored 22 goals last season, is also fully committed to staying at the club.

(Source: @TEAMtalk)
